full_judgment: 2. The aforesaid case arises out of a complaint made on 27.7.2008 by the opposite party No.2 Shafiqul Islam Howlader alleging inter alia that the accused petitioner herein created a certified copy of deed No. 2716 dated 22.2.1968 of Lakshmipur S.R. office showing Rokan Uddin Howlader, grandfather of the complainant as vendor and accused petitioner No.1 as vendee and accused petitioner No.2 was shown to be the identifier of the executant. Thereafter, accused petitioner No.1 transferred 0.15 acres of land out of 0.62 acres of land to accused petitioner No.3 by Hibabilawaz deed No. 149 dated 07.01.2008, on the basis of the aforesaid forged certified copy of the said deed and then instituted Title Suit No. 09 of 2008 on 09.01.2008 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Lakshmipur for declaration of their title in respect of the aforesaid land and used the aforesaid certified copy of the deed No. 2716 dated 22.02.1968 as genuine, knowing it well that the certified Copy of the deed is a forged document. Thereafter, the complainant searched the deed from Noakhali Record Room and came to learn that one Moshor Ali Pandit of Village-Rajibpur was the vendor and one Syedur Rahim of village-Rajibpur was vendee of the said sale deed and the same was in respect of 12 acres of land, appertaining to Plot No. 619 of Khatian No. 29 of Rajibpur Mouja.
